name: P.I.G. arm controller

requirements.text: PCA9685 answers at 0x40 with PRE_SCALE=121 (50 Hz) and its LEDn_OFF registers, read back over I2C, follow the 9-pose pick-and-place sequence in order
No joint's LEDn_OFF readback ever leaves its limit window (base 10-170, shoulder 30-150, elbow 20-160, wrist pitch 20-160, wrist roll 0-180, gripper 30-110 deg)
E-stop pressed after the first full cycle drives PCA9685 /OE (PA8) high and no pose is reported after it

model_boundary: PCA9685 pose register sequence, joint limit logic and emergency-stop state are verified; servo motion, collision, torque and physical arm operation are not.
